# v2.0.56

## Patient RX Rename And Document Upload Hotfix

- Renamed remaining `Daniely RX` defaults and labels to `Patient RX` across runtime defaults, Backoffice placeholders, Google Drive defaults, 2FA issuer fallback, QA labels, and operations documentation.
- Fixed document upload/list frontend handling so successful uploads no longer display raw JSON parser errors such as `Unexpected token '<'` when a follow-up response is HTML.
- Made patient/RX document calls proxy-aware with `window.rxUrl(...)` for FortiGate compatibility.
- Updated the build-machine `.env` Drive folder name to `Patient RX Documents`; existing `GOOGLE_DRIVE_ROOT_FOLDER_ID` still controls the actual Drive folder target when present.
- Hardened QA certificate handling after the QA passphrase rename.
- Fixed Needs Action smoke-test setup and row targeting so the optional smoke path verifies the intended expired workflow record.

## Validation

- `npm run test:rx-override` passed.
- Main QA smoke passed with `54 passed, 0 failed`.
- Needs Action QA smoke passed with `65 passed, 0 failed`.
- Focused document upload/list API test passed: upload returned `201 application/json`, list returned `200 application/json`.
